# Deliberate project contract exceptions to Go mdf. URI entries preserve `://`
# as an atomic delimiter at narrow ANSI widths rather than emitting `https:`
# followed by a wrapped `//host`. `ansi` is a final-output divergence; `trace`
# is an emission-boundary divergence. These are intentional, not parity
# regressions to restore. Every ANSI/trace skipped case has styled and boring
# zero-margin libmdf ANSI goldens at its exact width, plus at least four ANSI
# goldens for the source; every HTML exception has exact HTML goldens.
# Go mdf places inline-code link-label text outside the OSC8 hyperlink and
# parses ***foo** as combined emphasis. Libmdf instead keeps styled labels
# clickable and follows CommonMark's literal-* plus strong interpretation.
# These exact libmdf goldens make that deliberate behavioral authority
# explicit rather than silently weakening the parity gate.
# Go mdf retains the table-level pipe escape inside code spans. Libmdf
# consumes that escape as requested, following GFM tables Example 200;
# other code backslashes and code outside tables remain literal.
# Literal NBSP has a byte-scoped comparison exception in parityjudge, not a
# file exclusion: Go emits SPACE while libmdf preserves U+00A0. Goldens for
# testdata/parity-regressions/literal-nbsp.md pin the original ANSI/HTML bytes;
# original C bytes/traces compare across fragments, and an NBSP-to-SPACE input
# control checks the document's final output against the existing parity oracle.
# Go turns plain intraword underscores into spaces or opens emphasis. Keep
# these characters literal, including the essay's math-like $I_{k,j}(F)$ text.
# Named exceptions remain backed by exact ANSI/HTML goldens and native
# whole/fragmented sink/trace tests; ordinary emphasis rules are unchanged.
html testdata/10x.md
html testdata/parity__nbsp.md
ansi testdata/parity__nbsp.md 20
ansi testdata/parity__nbsp.md 40
